definition: to do better than anyone before
description: At a big indoor swimming pool a young woman in a navy swimsuit and white cap bursts up out of the water at the wall, raises both fists and shouts, her goggles in one hand. She drops down, smiles, then throws her arms up again and screams with joy. A large screen above shows NEW 55.12s with a gold star and the line PREVIOUS RECORD: 56.08s. A swimmer in the next lane stares with her mouth open, officials in white stand on the pool deck, and a packed crowd cheers in the stands.
